project_type: Full-stack medical app: Django 5 REST API backend + React 19 Vite SPA frontend (monorepo at d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai)
build_system: Backend: Django manage.py (venv at backend\.venv). Frontend: Vite 8 via npm scripts. NO Tailwind, NO Bootstrap — custom CSS only.
test_framework: No automated test suite configured. Verification = Django system check + Vite production build.
test_command: Backend check: cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1
verification_instructions:
1. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations 2>&1
2. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate 2>&1
3. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check 2>&1
4. cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build 2>&1
Expected: Django check shows 0 issues, Vite build completes without errors.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Python venv: d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe. Recharts is NOT installed (not in package.json) — use pure SVG charts. No new npm packages or pip packages allowed. SQLite database.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT rewrite from scratch. Reuse existing architecture, models, components, and CSS classes. No Tailwind, no Bootstrap, no new frameworks, no LangChain, no new AI providers. Custom CSS glassmorphism system: .glass-card, .btn-primary, .font-monospace, .text-theme-accent, etc.
key_patterns: Backend views: @api_view + @permission_classes + @csrf_exempt decorators. Sync Django with asyncio.run() wrapper called run_async(). All responses are JsonResponse. URL patterns use re_path with r'^.../?$'. Frontend: axios `api` instance from services/api.js at base http://127.0.0.1:8000/api. Inline styles match existing glassmorphism: background rgba(255,255,255,0.04), border rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Patient data fetched via /api/telemetry/emergency/ (requires JWT). Pathology data: PathologyReport.report_data is JSON list of {name, value, unit}. ML models loaded with pickle from backend/medical/ml_models/{heart_attack_rf.pkl,diabetes_rf.pkl,cancer_rf.pkl}.
